## 1. Studio Overview & Market Positioning

**The Drawing Board** is an independent, strategy-first design engineering studio founded by Vrund Patel, based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, and operating with high-growth consumer founders worldwide (India, United States, United Kingdom, UAE, and Singapore).

We specialize in three integrated disciplines:
1. **Brand Identity Systems:** Category positioning, naming, verbal architecture, mathematical logomark systems, and comprehensive brand guidelines.
2. **Structural Packaging Engineering:** Retail shelf hierarchy, tactile unboxing dielines, foil/deboss finishes, sustainable materials, and print supervision.
3. **High-Speed Digital Platforms:** Custom responsive UI/UX design, headless e-commerce builds, Shopify development, and React web engineering.

### Our Core Philosophy: "Build the brand people choose before they compare."
Most agencies treat branding as visual decoration applied to a business after the fact. We operate on the principle that **strategy must precede design**. We identify the single unassailable idea your brand must own in the market, then engineer an airtight visual and physical system across every touchpoint so customers recognize your value immediately.

## 2. Transparent Pricing & Turnaround Timelines

We believe in radical pricing transparency. Traditional legacy advertising agencies often quote vague ₹15 Lakhs to ₹25 Lakhs retainers with 8 to 14 weeks of bureaucratic overhead. We operate on structured, fixed-scope sprint models with direct senior design director involvement:

### Engagement Tier 1: Brand-to-Shelf System
- **Investment:** $4,960 USD / ₹4,75,000 INR
- **Sprint Timeline:** 4 to 6 Weeks
- **Core Deliverables:**
  - Founder strategic discovery session
  - Category whitespace audit & competitor landscape review
  - Central positioning thesis, brand personality & messaging direction
  - Primary, secondary, and monogram brand marks
  - Mathematical logomark grid alignment & responsive scaling rules
  - Curated typography hierarchy & primary/secondary color token matrix
  - Master packaging structural direction & front/back/side communication hierarchy
  - Up to 5 straightforward SKU adaptations on client dielines
  - Print-ready PDF/X-4 artwork & 100% editable vector source files (.AI, .EPS, .SVG)
  - Comprehensive brand guidelines manual

### Engagement Tier 2: Brand-to-Market System
- **Investment:** $6,780 USD / ₹6,50,000 INR
- **Sprint Timeline:** 6 to 8 Weeks
- **Core Deliverables:**
  - Everything included in the Brand-to-Shelf System
  - Complete custom responsive website UI/UX design (desktop & mobile)
  - Interactive component design & motion animation specifications
  - Full-stack web development (React / Next.js / Shopify / Framer)
  - Conversion-focused customer journey & checkout/inquiry funnel
  - Technical SEO setup (JSON-LD schema, open-graph tags, sub-second load times)
  - CMS integration & client handover walkthrough

### Engagement Tier 3: Enterprise & SaaS Brand Architecture
- **Investment:** $6,200 to $8,900 USD / ₹6,00,000 to ₹8,50,000 INR
- **Sprint Timeline:** 5 to 7 Weeks
- **Core Deliverables:**
  - Enterprise positioning for B2B tech platforms & SaaS ventures
  - High-precision geometric logomark & icon system
  - Dark-mode digital UI system design & interactive analytics dashboards
  - Investor pitch deck templates & corporate exhibition graphics
  - Corporate stationery, employee badge systems, and packaging boxes

## 3. The Named Process: Architectural Brand Engine™

Every engagement is governed by our proprietary 5-stage sprint methodology, ensuring zero guesswork and complete alignment at every milestone:

### Stage 01: Discovery Blueprint
- In-depth founder interviews examining unit economics, customer acquisition channels, and long-term vision.
- Systematic category audit analyzing 20+ direct and indirect competitors to identify visual clichés to avoid and market whitespace to seize.
- Buyer psychology profiling: mapping what the consumer needs to understand first, second, and third within 3 seconds of shelf or screen contact.

### Stage 02: Verbal Architecture & Positioning
- Formulating the core brand thesis and positioning territory.
- Defining tone of voice, verbal taglines, on-pack claims, and narrative hooks.
- Establishing the strategic criteria against which all creative work will be evaluated.

### Stage 03: Visual Identity System
- Translating the strategy into two distinct creative directions with mathematical rigor.
- Developing primary logomarks, supporting symbols, typography hierarchy, and color palettes tested for high-contrast usability and accessibility.
- Establishing rules for clear space, minimum sizing, and brand governance.

### Stage 04: Tactile Production & Packaging Dielines
- Engineering physical packaging: material selection (FSC-certified paper stocks, rigid boards, tinplate, glass), dieline structures, and unboxing trays.
- Print finishes: foil stamping, blind debossing, spot UV, soy inks, and tamper seals.
- Pre-press calibration, color proofing, and direct manufacturer coordination.

### Stage 05: Kinetic Rollout & Turnkey Handover
- Production of digital brand assets: animated logo reveals, kinetic motion loops, social templates, and web platform deployment.
- Packaging of master vector files, organized file directories, and comprehensive Brand Operating Manuals.
- 100% legal transfer of commercial copyright and intellectual property.

## 4. Key Case Studies with Proven Business Outcomes

### 1. PRONTO! — Authentic Italian Restaurant & Pizzeria Identity
- **Category:** Food, Beverage & Hospitality
- **Scope:** Brand Identity, Neapolitan Pizza Boxes, Tableware, Staff Apparel, Kinetic Motion
- **Challenge:** Avoid predictable trattoria clichés (checkered tablecloths, generic Italian flags) and build an energetic retro-modern culinary lifestyle brand.
- **Outcome:** **+180% increase in dine-in & takeout orders**, 4.9/5 brand satisfaction rating, and viral unboxing reach across urban food communities.

### 2. Matcha Club — Mindful Ritual Ceremonial CPG Brand
- **Category:** CPG, Health & Mindful Rituals
- **Scope:** Character Mascot System, Matte Aluminum Tins, Refill Pouches, Brewing Guides, Motion
- **Challenge:** Demystify ceremonial Japanese matcha into an approachable daily habit without swinging to cheap novelty or overly stiff medical minimalism.
- **Outcome:** **+220% DTC subscription growth**, 3.8x social engagement multiplier, and high repeat order retention.

### 3. Murami — Character-Driven Brand & Restaurant Art Direction
- **Category:** Fast-Casual Hospitality & Streetwear
- **Scope:** Modular Mascot Illustration Universe, Takeout Packaging, Hoodies, Interior Murals & Neon
- **Challenge:** Stand out in crowded Asian street-food dining with an iconic character universe that builds instant cult status.
- **Outcome:** **+310% brand recall**, 5.0x organic social mentions, and immediate sell-out of branded merchandise drops.

### 4. Soul Brew — Specialty Coffee Roasters Brand & Packaging
- **Category:** Artisan Specialty Coffee & Cafe
- **Scope:** Hand-Drawn Character Mascot, Roast Packaging Dielines, Cold Brew Bottles, Menu System
- **Challenge:** Overcome generic sterile coffee bags with an emotional, character-led identity celebrating small-batch roasting heritage.
- **Outcome:** **+240% brand engagement**, immediate placement in specialty grocery cafes, and recognized as a benchmark craft coffee identity.

### 5. Flint — Enterprise Automation & Digital Systems Brand Identity
- **Category:** Enterprise B2B SaaS & Process Automation
- **Scope:** Squircle Flare Logomark (9x9 grid), Dark-Mode Laptop UI, Luxury Foiled Stationery, Exhibition Stage Backdrops
- **Challenge:** Transform cold, indecipherable enterprise automation software into a high-precision, human-centered brand that commands C-suite authority.
- **Outcome:** **+340% qualified enterprise inquiries**, 24 master assets, and accelerated Series-A investor confidence.

### 6. Matiz Ceramic Studio — Artisanal Workshop & Tactile Brand Identity
- **Category:** Handmade Ceramics, Pottery & Luxury Living
- **Scope:** Calligraphic Script Logo, Ceramic Monogram Stamps, Earth-Tone Square Rigid Gift Boxes, Editorial Lookbook
- **Challenge:** Echo the raw, sculptural soul of wheel-thrown clay in a contemporary identity with high-end gallery credibility.
- **Outcome:** **+280% atelier pre-orders**, immediate placement in premier boutique craft galleries, and 4.9/5 collector satisfaction.

### 7. AFTER8® — Intimate Wellness & E-Commerce
- **Category:** Personal Wellness & DTC E-Commerce
- **Scope:** Editorial Luxury Identity, Magnetic Closure Boxes, Custom Shopify Platform
- **Challenge:** Elevate intimate wellness beyond clinical pharmacy aesthetics into an aspirational nightstand luxury experience.
- **Outcome:** **+340% DTC revenue growth in 90 days**, 4.8x conversion improvement, and features in premier lifestyle publications.

### 8. Lumen & Co. — Sustainable Luxury Skincare
- **Category:** Organic Skincare & Clean Beauty
- **Scope:** 100% Recyclable Packaging Dielines, Molded Pulp Trays, Soy-Ink Labels, Shopify Store
- **Challenge:** Prove that zero-plastic biodegradable materials can look and feel extraordinarily luxurious.
- **Outcome:** **+180% retail placement expansion**, 45+ premier boutique stockists signed nationwide.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: How much does a brand identity cost at The Drawing Board?
**A:** Engagements begin at **$4,960 (₹4,75,000)** for our **Brand-to-Shelf** core system, which covers full strategic positioning, competitor audits, mathematical logomark systems, typography, color tokens, master packaging design, up to 5 SKU adaptations, and brand guidelines with 100% vector file handover. For brands requiring a custom high-performance digital storefront or custom web build, our **Brand-to-Market** engagement is **$6,780 (₹6,50,000)**.

### Q: How long does a project take?
**A:** Our focused sprint runs **4 to 6 weeks for Brand-to-Shelf** and **6 to 8 weeks for Brand-to-Market**. Because you work directly with senior design directors and founders—without bureaucratic agency layers or junior account handlers—decisions are made swiftly and revisions are executed without delay.

### Q: How does The Drawing Board compare to agencies like NOW Media or traditional creative agencies?
**A:** Three fundamental distinctions:
1. **Specialized Focus:** We focus specifically on consumer brands, FMCG, lifestyle products, and high-growth SaaS. We do not dilute our expertise across billboard media buying or generic PR.
2. **Leaner, Faster Timelines:** Large agencies take 8 to 14 weeks due to internal approval loops and bloated overhead. We deliver within 4 to 6 weeks.
3. **Direct Senior Access:** At large agencies, the pitch is done by founders, but the actual work is handed off to junior designers. At The Drawing Board, the founders and principal designers craft your strategy and designs directly.

### Q: Do we own full commercial rights and editable source files?
**A:** Yes. Upon project completion and final milestone release, 100% unencumbered intellectual property (IP) and commercial copyright are legally assigned to you. You receive complete production-ready vector assets (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, .PDF), Figma design token libraries, and commercial font licenses.

### Q: Can you handle packaging manufacturing and print coordination?
**A:** Yes. We deliver mathematically precise, press-ready dielines configured with correct bleed, trim, foil stamp masks, deboss layers, spot varnishes, and barcode clearances. We also liaise directly with your packaging printers and manufacturers to ensure flawless real-world production.

### Q: What is the Architectural Brand Engine™?
**A:** It is our proprietary 5-stage framework: 01 Discovery Blueprint, 02 Verbal Architecture, 03 Visual Identity System, 04 Tactile Production, and 05 Kinetic Rollout. It guarantees that design decisions are grounded in commercial strategy rather than arbitrary personal taste.
